swamps.name: Flight, train, or a mix for Hanoi-to-HCMC, and in which order
swamps.one_liner: The country is 1,650km long and nobody has time to see it all; the wrong direction or mode burns a full travel day.

swamps.name: Day trip vs. overnight cruise, and which operator
swamps.one_liner: The boat you pick is also a safety decision, not just a budget one — real incidents have happened on the cheapest operators.

swamps.name: E-visa, visa exemption, or visa-on-arrival, and for how many days
swamps.one_liner: Getting this wrong can mean being turned away at the gate, not just a paperwork headache.

swamps.name: Rent and ride yourself, hire a driver, or skip it
swamps.one_liner: Vietnam's roads are genuinely dangerous for a first-timer, but also central to the classic trip (the Hai Van Pass, the countryside).

swamps.name: Sleeper train, sleeper bus, or a short flight for the long legs
swamps.one_liner: Comfort, cost, and real scam/quality risk on the cheapest sleeper buses.

swamps.name: A rushed day trip from Saigon vs. a multi-day homestay
swamps.one_liner: The Mekong Delta is one of the most commonly regretted bookings in the country when done as a rushed day trip.

swamps.name: How much cash to carry, and where cards quietly stop working
swamps.one_liner: Still a cash-heavy country outside the big cities; the wrong assumption leaves you stuck.

swamps.name: Hoi An Ancient Town, An Bang Beach, or Da Nang city
swamps.one_liner: Three completely different trips wearing the same 'Hoi An/Da Nang' label.

swamps.name: Independent trekking vs. a guided homestay tour in Sapa
swamps.one_liner: A real ethical and financial layer: unlicensed guides, high-pressure sales, and treks that oversell the experience.

swamps.name: Traveling during Tet (Lunar New Year) vs. timing around it
swamps.one_liner: Much of the country closes for up to a week and prices spike; not knowing this can wreck a trip's logistics.

swamps.name: Two days from Hanoi: Ha Long Bay or Ninh Binh
swamps.one_liner: Short trips can afford one, not both; the books frame the fork (Moon p97) and nobody resolves it.

swamps.name: How many days Hue deserves
swamps.one_liner: Three guidebooks give three answers (0, 1 or 2 days); every itinerary trips on it.
